reviewed_acceptable_items.review: Existing rules/signage/state vocabulary plus cumulative verbs already supports permission, prohibition, and ～ています. Project source gaps are mostly inflected forms or previously taught words; adding more would be filler.

This chapter is deliberately compositional: it links verbs/adjectives already learned. Existing routine/connective vocabulary is sufficient; forcing new words would duplicate earlier lexical capability.
Health, deadline, document, and obligation domains are already covered. The project-grounded 制服 candidate was removed in Gate 2B and is intentionally not reintroduced.

A real gap remained in independent change/transitivity and life-change verbs. Added lexical verbs for spending time, changing quantities/states, settling down, and recovery; no ～になる constructions were restored.
Plain-form practice is morphological and reuses cumulative nouns, verbs, and adjectives. New lexical inventory is not required to practice the grammar meaningfully.

The chapter had many abstract nouns but lacked enough independent verbs/adverbs for prediction, checking, correcting, informing, and discussion. Weather-prediction verbs are grounded in the actual Listening pilot.
Temporal vocabulary is already broad (sequence, departure/arrival, before/after, automatic events). Grammar patterns mainly combine this with cumulative action vocabulary.
The retained set was noun-heavy. Added independent help/entrust/delivery/care verbs so ～てあげる／～てもらう／～てくれる can be practiced with real actions.
Emergency nouns were strong, but dynamic hazard/state verbs were thin. Added common independent hazard verbs/adjective for realistic conditional sentences.
Procedural, document, counter/service, and inquiry vocabulary is already dense enough; polite-request grammar can reuse cumulative action verbs.
Ability/limit nouns are already extensive and potential forms must be generated by grammar, not duplicated as vocabulary. Cumulative verbs provide the actions to transform.
Gate 2B correctly removed many ながら/ので/ために phrases. Gate 2C adds only independent simultaneous-activity lexemes (commuting, concentrating, moving, balancing activities, going out, calling).
Many former candidates were ～てあります／～ておきます constructions. Added independent transitive preparation/completion verbs that naturally produce result-state examples without storing the grammar pattern.

The low count is intentional after removing intention/～ようになる constructions. Existing career/goal nouns and cumulative verbs already cover most practice; only 目指す and 実現する fill genuine goal-directed lexical gaps. No N3-heavy career padding was added.
Health, habit, time-management, advice, and decision vocabulary is already sufficient. The grammar deliberately reuses prior action verbs to form habits and recommendations.
Contrast/condition abstractions are already strong. Added simple opposite outcomes 勝つ／負ける; rejected 逆 because 逆に already exists in the same chapter and would increase quiz ambiguity.
This chapter intentionally derives ～方, ～やすい／～にくい, and ～すぎる from cumulative lexical items. The retained method/tool vocabulary is already sufficient; derived grammar forms must not be reinserted.
The retained community/workplace inventory plus cumulative verbs is sufficient for passive, ～ところ, ～ばかり, and change-over-time patterns. 人口 was previously removed and is intentionally not reintroduced.
